annotations.title: Remove a document from a knowledge base

description: Removes one ingested document and all its chunks; searches stop returning it at once. Get the documentId from workbench_kb_documents_list. To replace a document, remove it then workbench_kb_add_documents the new version. May return `needs_confirmation`.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation response. Omit on the first call.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: workbench_kb_document_delete
title: Remove a document from a knowledge base
